notes.title: Cirno's Battle of Faith has been released！
notes.content:
The formal version of 《琪露诺的信仰之战 ~ Cirno's battle of faith》Now officially released！

This is the Creator 3rd Program! According to your evaluation, after several weeks of adjustment and final development, we are honored to present to you the formal version of《琪露诺的信仰之战 ~ Cirno's battle of faith》 ! In the previous EA phase, we have received many valuable comments and suggestions from players. Thank you for your enthusiastic support to Creator team and this game! Here we display the modifications made in the formal version as follows:

· A level from Chapter 2 was reworked to match the theme of that level .
· Added extreme mode, in which killing enemies will not restore health to the player character. It is encouraging player to choose more accurate operation and  well censidered strategy!
· Added achievements system.
· Localization - including English and Japanese translation. (At present, there are still a few words that have not been translated. We will complete the translation of this part as soon as possible!)
· Tweaked some details in the game.

We will continue to maintain the game after the official release of《琪露诺的信仰之战 ~ Cirno's battle of faith》. Meanwhile, we will configure CG for the ending story of the game as soon as possible. Stay tuned!
Finally, thank you again for your attention and support to the Creator 3rd team!

notes.title: 《琪露诺的信仰之战 ~ Cirno's battle of faith》现已正式发售！
notes.content:
大家好，这里是樱游社Creator3rd团队。
我们制作的游戏《琪露诺的信仰之战 ~ Cirno's battle of faith》已经上架steam了。这是一个以琪露诺为主角的回合制休闲策略游戏，需要玩家发挥自己的策略能力，在敌人和机关的压力下寻找关卡出口，击倒关底boss，操作琪露诺拯救她的朋友。
这是我们制作的第一款游戏，难免会有不足之处，欢迎各位在游玩的途中向我们反馈游戏漏洞或是意见，qq交流群号是789572395，我们会尽力给大家带来良好的游戏体验，谢谢你们玩我们的游戏！
